name: Hotel Fairmont Palliser
positioning: Fairmont Palliser, a Fairmont hotel in downtown Calgary with a hotel-within-a-hotel Fairmont Gold level, Hawthorn Dining Room and rnr Wellness spa
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Calgary base within easy reach of the Calgary Tower and Calgary Zoo
Guests traveling with a dog or cat

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Calgary.
The hotel is within easy reach of shopping, cultural venues, the Calgary Tower and the Calgary Zoo.
Fairmont Gold is a private lounge level with a complimentary continental breakfast each morning and evening canapes.
Hawthorn Dining Room & Bar serves modern prairie fare.
Afternoon tea features specialty teas, oven-fresh scones, refined sandwiches and sweets.
Hawthorn hosts live music on Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
The hotel has rnr Wellness spa.
Guests have access to an indoor pool and health club.
The Heritage Suite has ornate architectural details, a kitchenette, a dining area and an ornamental fireplace.
The Wild Rose Suite has a living room with a historical fireplace and a kitchenette.
The hotel is pet-friendly and welcomes cats and dogs.
